raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Muse Spark with DSpark fails at startup on main: loading the draft raises `AttributeError: 'MuseSparkDSparkModel' object has no attribute '_context_kv_proj'`. Regressed by #64357. This PR initializes the attribute in `MuseSparkDSparkModel.__init__`.

## Claims

- Muse Spark + DSpark (`--speculative-config '{"method":"dspark",...}'`, the recipe's DSpark profiles) starts again. The failing code path is shared by CUDA and ROCm.
- DSpark acceptance is unchanged from before the regression.
- A unit test builds the real draft model and loads weights; it fails without the fix and passes with it.

## Validation

MI355X x8, image `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-76c6f3f2a95f6049657db1e513133b824a5c8175` (Muse and `qwen3_dflash.py` byte-identical to main `51c6dfd8c8`), target `amd/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-Quark-MXFP4`, draft `Inferact/Muse-Spark-Open-DSpark`, the recipe's AMD MXFP4 + DSpark command (TP8, K=7):

| | Startup | DSpark acceptance length | Per-position acceptance |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| nightly | `AttributeError` in every rank while loading the draft | - | - |
| nightly + this PR | OK | 3.900 | 0.802 0.625 0.482 0.365 0.274 0.203 0.148 |
| before #64357 (main `19c0e170d2`) | OK | 3.913 | 0.806 0.634 0.491 0.373 0.280 0.206 0.147 |
| model card | | 3.94 | |

Acceptance: 256 GSM8K test questions as chat requests, T=1.0, top-p 0.95, max 2048 tokens, concurrency 16; acceptance length = 1 + accepted / drafts from `vllm:spec_decode_*` metrics. Run-to-run spread at T=1.0 is about 0.05.

<details>
<summary>Serve command and stock traceback</summary>

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 VLLM_ROCM_MUSE_MOE_REDUCE_DTYPE=bf16 VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=1 \
AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN_SHORT_QUERY_3D=1 VLLM_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT=LBHNC VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND=0 \
vllm serve amd/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-Quark-MXFP4 --dtype bfloat16 \
  --distributed-executor-backend mp --language-model-only \
  --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE"}' --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --enable-chunked-prefill --tensor-parallel-size 8 --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_FA \
  --max-model-len 32768 --max-num-seqs 32 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 --reasoning-parser muse --tool-call-parser muse \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","model":"Inferact/Muse-Spark-Open-DSpark","num_speculative_tokens":7,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic","rejection_sample_method":"block","enable_adaptive_verification":false,"attention_backend":"ROCM_AITER_FA"}'
```

```text
  File "vllm/v1/worker/gpu/spec_decode/dspark/utils.py", line 120, in load_dspark_model
    draft_model = get_model(
  ...
  File "vllm/models/muse_spark/common/dspark.py", line 375, in load_weights
    return AutoWeightsLoader(self).load_weights(
  File "vllm/model_executor/models/utils.py", line 407, in _load_module
    loaded_params = module_load_weights(weights)
  File "vllm/model_executor/models/qwen3_dflash.py", line 839, in load_weights
    proj = self._context_kv_proj
AttributeError: 'MuseSparkDSparkModel' object has no attribute '_context_kv_proj'
```

</details>

Tests (in the same image, without and with the fix):

```bash
pytest tests/transformers_utils/test_muse_spark_config.py
# without the fix: 1 failed (test_dspark_draft_loads_weights, the AttributeError above), 8 passed
# with the fix:    9 passed
```

`pre-commit` hooks `ruff-check`, `ruff-format`, `typos`, and `mypy` (3.11) pass on the changed files.

## Details

Root cause: #64357 moved the creation of the MXFP8 context K/V projection from `_build_fused_kv_buffers` (run at the end of `load_weights`) into `DFlashQwen3Model.__init__`, and `DFlashQwen3Model.load_weights` now reads `self._context_kv_proj`. `MuseSparkDSparkModel` inherits `load_weights` but calls `nn.Module.__init__` instead of the parent's `__init__`, so the attribute never exists. `AutoWeightsLoader` reaches the inherited `load_weights` through `MuseSparkDSparkForCausalLM.load_weights` and fails.

Fix: set `self._context_kv_proj = None`. Muse projects its context K/V in `_project_muse_context_kv` (from the weights `_build_fused_kv_buffers` stacks) and never uses the parent's MXFP8 projection, so `None` keeps the pre-#64357 behavior. Of the other `DFlashQwen3Model` subclasses, the two that also skip the parent `__init__` never reach the inherited `load_weights`: Laguna DFlash overrides it, and Gemma4 DSpark loads parameters directly from its `ForCausalLM`.

Why CI missed it: the Muse DSpark registry entry is `is_available_online=False` and the model initialization test loads dummy weights, so no CI job runs the draft's `load_weights`. The new test does; `tests/transformers_utils` is currently not run by any Buildkite step (the step is commented out in `.buildkite/test_areas/misc.yaml`), so it is covered only by local runs until that step is re-enabled.

Not a duplicate: no open issue or PR mentions `_context_kv_proj` or this failure; #64692 and #64690 touch weight loading but not this attribute. #65080, the other Muse fix today, merged the duplicate `process_weights_after_loading` from #64357 and #63440 in `amd/model.py` and does not touch the draft.

AI assistance (Claude) was used to investigate, write, and validate this change; I reviewed every line and reran the validation above.

- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.

</details>
